title: Origins++ Turkish translation
description: A texture pack that translates the Origins++ mod into Turkish
body:
## Origins++ Turkish Translation

An unofficial community resource pack that translates all Origins++ mod content into Turkish.

### 📦 What's Included

This resource pack provides Turkish translations for:
- All origin names and descriptions
- Power descriptions and details
- In-game texts and notifications
- UI elements and interface strings

### 🎮 How to Use

1. Download the resource pack
2. Place it in your `.minecraft/resourcepacks` folder
3. Launch Minecraft
4. Navigate to Options > Resource Packs and activate it
5. Set your game language to Turkish (Türkçe)

### ✅ Compatibility

- **Required Mod:** Origins++
- **Minecraft Version:** [Specify your version]
- **Mod Version:** [Specify supported mod version]

### 📝 Note

This is an unofficial community translation. The pack will be updated as the mod receives updates.
